# New-ZbxTask

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a task for the server to run now.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxTask [-Type] <ZabbixTaskType> [-Request] <ZabbixTaskRequest> [-ProxyId <ulong>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The New-ZbxTask cmdlet creates a server task with task.create: a check of an item now (-Type CheckNow), a dump of the server's internal state (DiagnosticInformation) or a configuration push to proxies (ProxyConfigurationReload). -Request carries what the task needs, cast from a hashtable: the item id, the diagnostic sections, or the proxy ids. It reads the created tasks back and writes them; Invoke-ZbxCheckNow, Invoke-ZbxDiagnostic and Sync-ZbxProxyConfig are the shorter forms of the three.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Check an item now

```powershell
$item = Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Uptime'
New-ZbxTask -Type CheckNow -Request @{ itemid = $item.ItemId } | Select-Object TaskId, Type, Status
```

The same task Invoke-ZbxCheckNow creates; -Request names the item by its id.

### Example 2: Ask for the history cache statistics

```powershell
New-ZbxTask -Type DiagnosticInformation -Request @{ historycache = @{ stats = 'extend' } } | Select-Object TaskId, Type
```

A diagnostic task; Get-ZbxTask shows its Result once the server has run it.
